chapter: Mambo, the Palladium and Cubop City
title: Steady work at the Palladium; Tito Puente's Picadilly Boys
summary: The band stayed fourteen to twenty weeks; discharged from the navy, Puente organized a group for a five o'clock matinee.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: So then the first orchestra to play in the Palladium was the Machito orchestra, in 1947.
I see. Okay, fine. All right. Once you started this, did you work at the Palladium steady?
Oh, yes, we was there for fourteen, fifteen or twenty weeks; and Tito Puente, he had a discharge from the
navy, so he was working at the Coacabana so we organized a group. They called it "Picadilly's Boys", in order to play from five to six, one hour. So he started the matinee from five to six,
with the Picadilly Boys, about five or six pieces that he come an idea that he organized his .....
